pi.goal_mode_reason: Installed Pi has no Goal-mode extension and control-origin semantics could not be established safely; asymmetric Goal mode was not allowed.

orchid.database: fresh benchmark-only state orchid-state-actual-2/memory.db, created after all provider and RPC smoke tests and invalid attempt 01

known_limitations: Agent subprocess outbound network access is not firewall-denied; remotes and hidden refs were removed, and the limitation is recorded for this exploratory run.
The Pi installation has no Goal-mode extension, so the common safe configuration is Goal mode disabled for both arms.
Solar pricing, provider routing, and availability may change; the exact slug and endpoint are frozen in this manifest.
The ORCHID checkout contains pre-existing user working-tree changes; only its recorded implementation state is used, and private benchmark harness files are outside sealed agent repositories.
